definitions.explanation: The month before this one; the previous month. Used to refer to events or states in the month that just passed.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦{新|あたら}しい→あたらしい：00506⟧⟦{車|くるま}→くるま：00516⟧⟦を→を：00422⟧⟦{買|か}いました→かう：00489⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new car last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦{友達|ともだち}→ともだち：01478⟧⟦に→に：00314⟧⟦{会|あ}いました→あう：00482⟧。
examples.english: I met my friend last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦は→は：00079⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→いそがしい：00591⟧⟦です→です：09485⟧。⟦{毎日|まいにち}→まいにち：00729⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→しごと：00480⟧⟦が→が：00051⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006⟧。
examples.english: I was busy last month. I had work every day.
My mother came to Japan last month, but she already went back.
It rained every day last month. The weather is good this month, so I'm happy.

notes:
{先月|せんげつ} means 'last month' and is part of the time reference system.

TIME SERIES - MONTHS:
- {先々月|せんせんげつ}: the month before last
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→こんげつ：00720⟧: this month
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→らいげつ：00744⟧: next month
- ⟦{再来月|さらいげつ}→さらいげつ：01418⟧: the month after next

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {先|せん}: previous, before
- {月|げつ}: month

SIMILAR WORDS WITH {先|せん}:
- ⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→せんしゅう：00752⟧: last week
- ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→せんじつ：03305⟧: the other day
- {先年|せんねん}: years ago, previous years

GRAMMAR NOTES:
- Used as time adverb without particle: {先月|せんげつ}{行|い}った (I went last month)
- Used as noun with の: {先月|せんげつ}の⟦{売|う}り{上|あ}げ→うりあげ：04102⟧ (last month's sales)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先月|せんげつ}の{末|まつ}: end of last month
- {先月|せんげつ}の⟦{初|はじ}め→はじめ：02931⟧: beginning of last month
